stories.title: DeepSeek Open-Sources R1 Reasoning Weights & Distill Suite Under MIT
stories.summary: Full 671B MoE reasoning weights and 1.5B–70B distilled models released under MIT license. Architecture relies on Multi-Head Latent Attention and pure RL without SFT cold-start.

stories.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Code CLI & Updates Model Context Protocol Standard
stories.summary: Anthropic unveiled Claude Code, an agentic terminal tool for autonomous multi-file refactoring, alongside MCP 2026-07-28 transition to a stateless universal context architecture.

stories.title: OpenAI Launches o3-mini Reasoning Model with Granular Effort Controls in API
stories.summary: OpenAI rolled out o3-mini for coding, math, and STEM reasoning, featuring low, medium, and high reasoning effort tiers alongside structured output and developer message support.

stories.title: Google Releases Gemini 2.0 Flash into GA with Realtime Multimodal Live API
stories.summary: Gemini 2.0 Flash is now generally available via Google AI Studio and Vertex API. Includes sub-300ms bidirectional audio/video streaming, built-in search grounding, and code execution.

stories.title: Alibaba Ships Qwen 2.5-Coder 32B: Matches GPT-4o on EvalPlus Benchmarks
stories.summary: Alibaba Cloud released Qwen 2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct, achieving top-tier results across EvalPlus, MultiPL-E, and repo-level completion benchmarks with native 128k context support.

stories.title: vLLM 0.7 Lands Native DeepSeek MLA Kernels & Chunked Prefill Acceleration
stories.summary: Major vLLM engine release introduces fused Triton kernels for Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), cutting KV cache memory overhead by 70% and boosting MoE batch throughput 3.4x.

stories.title: Meta Releases Llama 3.3 70B: Delivers 405B-Level Quality at 70B Compute Cost
stories.summary: Meta open-sourced Llama 3.3 70B Instruct, matching the previous flagship 405B model across core industry benchmarks while retaining an efficient 70B architecture with 128k context.

stories.title: SWE-bench Verified Released: 500 Curated Problems to Eliminate Evaluation Noise
stories.summary: OpenAI and Princeton researchers released SWE-bench Verified, a curated subset of 500 real GitHub issues verified by human engineers to resolve under-specified test flakes.

stories.title: Hugging Face Releases smolagents: Code-First Agent Framework in <1k LOC
stories.summary: Hugging Face launched smolagents, a lightweight library where LLMs write raw executable Python actions instead of JSON tool blobs, slashing token overhead by 30%.

stories.title: Apple MLX Adds Native MoE Offloading & 2-bit Quantization on Apple Silicon
stories.summary: Apple's open-source MLX framework introduced fused Metal kernels for Mixture-of-Experts routing and sub-3-bit quantization, running 70B+ models on 64GB/128GB unified RAM.

stories.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources Cosmos World Foundation Models for Physical AI & Robotics
stories.summary: NVIDIA released Cosmos, a family of generative world foundation models designed for physical AI, robotics simulation, and autonomous vehicle synthetic trajectory generation.

stories.title: EU AI Act Enters Enforcement: Final Standards for GPAI Models and Synthetic Watermarking
stories.summary: EU AI Office published final technical guidance as the AI Act enters initial enforcement phases, mandating machine-readable watermarks and training data transparency summaries.
